 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE) -- Added by Kishore on 04/23/2012. IM 8446

 )
 )
 and not exists
 (select 'x'

 and coll_date = :coll_date 
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id 
 and component_sp.product_code = components.product_code

 and not exists

Trigger.Name: COMMIT_TRANSACTION
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :process_code = 'THAW'
 then
 begin
 insert into utrs
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, test_seq_no,
 test_id, insert_dats, insert_user_id, program_id)
 select :unit_id, :coll_date, :s_chapter_id, 1,
 test_id, sysdate, :banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name
 from contract_tests
 where contract_id = (select contract_id
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id 
 and coll_date = :coll_date 
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id) 
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and stop_label_flag = 'Y' 
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/23/2012. IM 8446
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) between 
 eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10) --Added by Kishore on 04/23/2012. IM 8446
 and not exists
 (select 'x'
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 utrs.test_id =
 contract_tests.test_id and
 cancel_flag is null
 union
 select 'x'
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 unit_test_base.test_id =
 contract_tests.test_id and
 cancel_flag is null);
 if sql%found
 then
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from component_attributes
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 attrib_group = 'ALERT' and
 attrib_code = 'REPO';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0003');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in trying to check for repository samples');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting in UTRs');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 begin
 insert into component_sp
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, component_prefix,
 product_code, process_code, insert_dats,
 insert_user_id, patient_id, program_id )
 values
 (:unit_id, :coll_date, :s_chapter_id, :component_prefix,
 :product_code, :process_code, sysdate, :banner.user_id,
 :patient_id, :banner.prog_name);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting into component_sp');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if not form_success
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 :patient_id := '';
 down;
 end if;
end;

 OR (system_label_decision IS NULL
 AND :process_code IN ('LYMP','GRAN','STEM')))

 AND lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE) BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,sysdate+10)
 AND NOT EXISTS
 (SELECT 'x'

 AND chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 AND component_sp.product_code = components.product_code
 AND component_sp.component_prefix = components.component_prefix

 )

 valid_interdictions_lab

 AND coll_date = :coll_date
 AND chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 AND component_interdictions.product_code = components.product_code
 AND component_interdictions.inter_code =
 valid_interdictions_lab.inter_code
 AND inter_type IN ('N','B','H')
 AND component_interdictions.insert_dats >= NVL(label_dats, component_interdictions.insert_dats-1)
 UNION

 FROM unit_interdictions,
 valid_interdictions_lab
 WHERE unit_id = :unit_id

 )

 )

 AND val.process_code = :process_code
